name: Link
what_it_does: Opens the Insert Hyperlink dialog to link the selection to webpages, files, headings or email addresses; the dropdown lists recent items.
affects: the selection (wraps it in a hyperlink)
behavior: Opens Insert Hyperlink (dialog). Contents (26 controls): Current Folder, Browsed Pages, Recent Files, Existing File or Web Page, Place in This Document, Create New Document, E-mail Address, RichEdit Control, Line up, Page down, Line down, RichEdit Control, Context help, Close, Text to display:, ScreenTip.... Sub-surfaces: ui:insert-link-dialog-screentip, ui:insert-link-dialog-bookmark, ui:insert-link-dialog-target-frame. [the Insert Hyperlink dialog; enumerated across 1 tab(s)] Appears as two chain links, labelled 'Link', with a dropdown.
